scene: A traditional archive restoration room on a rainy afternoon. She kneels on a cushion beside a low wooden worktable, flattening an unlettered old illustrated folio with a soft brush in one hand and the other resting on the page edge, hands separated. Diffuse gray skylight and warm desk lamp; full head, hands and feet visible, one adult conservator.
outfit: A sleeveless indigo linen high-neck wrap tunic, cream sash and knee-length hem over securely opaque short underlayers, soft flat shoes, tiny gold geometric bracelet. Bare arms and lower legs, original heritage-inspired conservator clothing with complete chest and pelvis coverage, no armor.
